bug: Nightly export job hangs on accounts with more than 10k invoices

hypotheses.statement: The paginator re-requests the last page when the total is an exact multiple of the page size
hypotheses.prediction: If the paginator loops on the final page, then a fixture with 10000 invoices hangs and one with 10001 completes
hypotheses.experiment: Run the loop against fixtures with 10000 and 10001 invoices and compare

hypotheses.statement: A database lock taken by the invoice-total trigger blocks the export cursor
hypotheses.prediction: If the trigger lock is the cause, then disabling the trigger in the test database makes the job finish
hypotheses.experiment: Disable the trigger in the fixture database and rerun the loop

hypotheses.statement: The CSV writer buffers the whole export in memory and stalls in swap
hypotheses.prediction: If memory pressure is the cause, then peak RSS climbs past 2 GB before the hang
hypotheses.experiment: Record peak RSS during the loop with the standard resource module
hypotheses.evidence: Peak RSS stayed at 180 MB across 10 red runs

experiments.change: Sampled peak RSS during the run
